ResearchProjectDef.label: automated smelter kludging
ResearchProjectDef.description: Work out how to patch a wrecked automated smelter back into crude service: which breaches to plate over, which coils to splice by hand, and how little of it can be made to run. Needs a wrecked smelter that a researcher has studied.\n\nOnce this is done, order the kludge on the wrecked smelter where it stands.

ResearchProjectDef.label: automated smelter refurbishment
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to bring a kludged automated smelter close to what it was. This is not the smelter's original engineering, which its makers already solved. It is the colony's own hard-won knowledge of how to bring a dead one back. Needs a kludged smelter that a researcher has studied.\n\nOnce this is done, order the refurbishment on the kludged smelter where it stands. It needs an ancient component.

ResearchProjectDef.label: power cell kludging
ResearchProjectDef.description: Work out how to coax a wrecked vanometric power cell back into a trickle of power by bypassing its dead lattice with ordinary cable. Needs a wrecked power cell that a researcher has studied.\n\nOnce this is done, order the kludge on the wrecked power cell where it stands.

ResearchProjectDef.label: power cell refurbishment
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to restore most of a kludged power cell's lattice. Nobody understands how the cell makes power; this is only how to stop it losing so much of it. Needs a kludged power cell that a researcher has studied.\n\nOnce this is done, order the refurbishment on the kludged power cell where it stands. It needs an ancient component.

ResearchProjectDef.label: psychic emanator kludging
ResearchProjectDef.description: Work out how to patch a wrecked psychic emanator into a weak, uneven field. Needs a wrecked emanator that a researcher has studied.\n\nOnce this is done, order the kludge on the wrecked emanator where it stands.

ResearchProjectDef.label: psychic emanator refurbishment
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to steady a kludged psychic emanator's field. The principle is beyond anyone; the repair is only careful copying of what survived. Needs a kludged emanator that a researcher has studied.\n\nOnce this is done, order the refurbishment on the kludged emanator where it stands. It needs an ancient component.

ResearchProjectDef.label: alloy forge restoration
ResearchProjectDef.description: Bring an ancient alloy forge back to heat. Once the smelter runs, the forge is the next furnace down the line: it bonds refined metal with a hardening mineral into tougher alloys.\n\nRestoring it unlocks the forge and its first, easiest alloys. Harder alloys need further study.

ResearchProjectDef.label: plasteel alloying
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to drive the restored alloy forge hard enough to fuse plasteel: steel, chemfuel and a trace of gold under heat and pressure the forge was built for and has not reached in a lifetime.\n\nUnlocks the forge's plasteel recipe, the only way the colony can make plasteel itself.
